issue.title: drone.telemetry.scaled_pressure() hangs
issue.body:
Hi there,

I am trying to get the atmospheric pressure from the drone but the code hangs forever at the async call without any error.

    # get atmospheric pressure at takeoff location
    async for pre in drone.telemetry.scaled_pressure():
        pressure=pre.absolute_pressure_hpa
        print("Pressure at takeoff location: %.2fmbar" %(pressure))
        break

Using mavsdk Python on Windows 
PX4 mini and mavsdk have been updated to latest version

thanks for help

comments.body: If you never receive any `scaled_pressure` in the `async for`, it suggests that PX4 does not send them. Could it be?
That makes sense! Do you know about any plans to make those available to telemetry? Havent found any parameter to turn them on...

There's no parameter to enable it. They are supported but not sent by default. You will have to request the autopilot to stream the messages using MAVLink [MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL](https://mavlink.io/en/messages/common.html#MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL) or enabling them by default using the `mavlink` module commands: https://dev.px4.io/master/en/middleware/modules_communication.html#mavlink.
found it, thank you. But the drone's barometric pressure is about 4m different than my ground station, so this is not very useful...
@olafwessler you might be able to correct/calibrate the baro altitude using a param. It might be this one: https://docs.px4.io/master/en/advanced_config/parameter_reference.html#SENS_BARO_QNH

@julianoes I am using the absolute pressure value from both drone and ground station. So applying the QNH calibration to both devices will not eliminate the difference..
By the way: As it is possible to receive pressure data from mavsdk and to set a calibration value by parameter, would it make sense to also allow to activate the data stream itself from PX4 by parameter?

I think you would only apply the calibration to one but maybe I don't understand the problem correctly. I just assume that these pressure sensors are not perfectly calibrated which is probably what you're finding.

> activate the data stream itself from PX4 by parameter?

You mean so that you don't have to use `set_rate_scaled_pressure()`?

I was hoping the `set_rate` commands are convenient enough. That's why there here. The problem is that otherwise we need to add a parameter for each and every MAVLink message because everyone is going to want a specific one. :smile:

I thought something like the SENS_EN_MB12XX parameter to activate a distance sensor would be very convenient. In particular, as the barometric pressure sensor is a standard build-in sensor in every pixhawk and the altitude value is already supported by mavsdk.
But I totally understand its getting too much at some point...
